name: Kofi Mensah
message: Augustine rebuilt our entire e-commerce frontend. Load times dropped by 40% and our mobile conversion rate went up 25% in the first month. He has an eye for detail that most devs miss.

name: Sarah Adjei
message: He built a custom dashboard for my logistics company. The UI is clean, it works flawlessly on tablets in the warehouse, and he delivered two weeks early. Rare find.

name: Michael Osei
message: I've worked with several freelancers and Augustine stands out. Great communicator, writes maintainable code, and actually cares about the end-user experience, not just ticking boxes.

name: Ama Serwaa
message: He redesigned my startup's landing page and it went from a 2% to 7% conversion rate just from layout and copy changes. He understands business goals, not just code.

name: James Nkrumah
message: Augustine helped us migrate a legacy PHP app to Next.js. The project was complex but he handled it with zero downtime and documented everything so well our team could maintain it easily.

name: Esi Foriwaa
message: Our nonprofit needed a donor portal fast. Augustine built it in three weeks — payment integration, donor dashboard, email receipts — and didn't charge us the full rate knowing it was for a good cause. Class act.
